title: Bottle o' Ghast
description: Put a happy ghast in a bottle!
body:
# Bottle o' Ghast

I made this mod in roughly 3 hours for my friend. It's very simple and very stupid.

## How to Use

Right click on a happy ghast with an empty bottle to put it in one. Right click with a Bottle o' Ghast to throw it, spawning your happy ghast back wherever it lands.

### A Word of Warning

Be cautious when throwing your beloved happy ghast. If the spawn location ends up under an overhang, it can and will suffocate in a wall.
